[[Landskrona]] | capacity = 10,500 | chairman = Anders Ekbladh | manager = Robin Asterhed | league = [[Superettan]] | season = [[2025 Superettan|2025]] | position = 9th | website = {{URL|https://landskronabois.se/}} | pattern_la1 = _landskronabois26h | pattern_b1 = _landskronabois26h | pattern_ra1 = _landskronabois26h | pattern_sh1 = _adidastirol26bw | pattern_so1 = _3_stripes_black | leftarm1 = FFFFFF | body1 = FFFFFF | rightarm1 = FFFFFF | shorts1 = 000000 | socks1 = FFFFFF | pattern_la2 = _landskronabois26a | pattern_b2 = _landskronabois26a | pattern_ra2 = _landskronabois26a | pattern_sh2 = _adidastirol26prw | pattern_so2 = _3_stripes_white | leftarm2 = EF0000 | body2 = EF0000 | rightarm2 = EF0000 | shorts2 = EF0000 | socks2 = EF0000 | pattern_la3 = | pattern_b3 = | pattern_ra3 = | pattern_sh3 = | pattern_so3 = | leftarm3 = | body3 = | rightarm3 = | shorts3 = | socks3 = }} '''Landskrona Boll och Idrottsällskap''' ({{langx|en|Landskrona Ball and Sports Society}}, locally referred to as '''BoIS''') is a Swedish professional [[association football|football]] club located in [[Landskrona]], [[Scania]], which currently plays in [[Superettan]], the second league tier of [[football in Sweden]]. The club was formed on 7 February 1915 through the merger of two Landskrona clubs, ''IFK Landskrona'' and ''Landskrona BK'' (earlier known as Diana BK).{{cite web|url=https://boishistoria.se/nar-bois-blev-bois/|title=När BoIS blev BoIS|publisher=BoIS historia|author=David|language=Swedish|date=23 October 2019|access-date=13 February 2021|archive-date=27 June 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210627145845/https://boishistoria.se/nar-bois-blev-bois/|url-status=live}} Landskrona BoIS was one of the twelve teams participating in the [[1924–25 Allsvenskan|inaugural Allsvenskan season]] in 1924–25. Since then, they have participated in 34 seasons in [[Allsvenskan]] and 54 seasons in the second highest division. Landskrona BoIS has won four medals in Allsvenskan, little silver in [[1937–38 Allsvenskan|1937–38]] and bronze in [[1938–39 Allsvenskan|1938–39]], [[1975 Allsvenskan|1975]] and [[1976 Allsvenskan|1976]], as well as one national cup title, in 1971–72. [[File:Landskrona BoIS League Performance.png|right|thumb|Season by season chart. Landskrona BoIS positions within the Swedish league system]] The club also played ice hockey during the late 1950s and early 1960s.{{cite web|url=https://landskronabois.se/klubben/historia/|title=Vår historia|publisher=Landskrona BoIS|language=Swedish|accessdate=23 October 2023}}"}}
